value.rationale: This is an all-order exact recovery guarantee for the first corner-deleted triangle: a trapezoid with parallel sides outside the classic geometry-only uniqueness hypothesis. Parity protects Fourier intensity injectivity against every complex-valued competitor, while explicit strictly positive integer ambiguous partners show the support alone offers no such protection. The arithmetic/geometry interaction is a nontrivial boundary principle for constrained aperture and imaging problems.
